description: This file contains utility functions, classes, and methods for managing distributed tensor operations in PyTorch, including context management for redistribution constraints, shape and offset computations, and tensor shape transformations for distributed training.

classes.name: ExplicitRedistributionContext
classes.description: A context manager that temporarily disables implicit redistribution during DTensor operations to enforce manual control, with configurable strictness and mode (raise or warn).

methods.name: str _format_implicit_redistribution_msg(schema: OpSchema)
methods.description: Generates a message indicating implicit redistribution occurs for a given operation schema.

methods.name: tuple[tuple[int,...],tuple[int,...]] compute_local_shape_and_global_offset( global_shape: ShapeType, mesh: DeviceMesh, placements: Sequence[Placement], skip_offset: bool = False, )
methods.description: Computes the local tensor shape and global offsets based on global shape, device mesh, and placements, useful for distributed checkpointing.

methods.name: tuple[int,torch.Tensor|None] _get_shard_size_and_offsets( curr_local_size: int, mesh_dim_size: int, rank: RankType, placement: Shard | _StridedShard, previous_offsets, zero_global_offset: int, skip_offset: bool, )
methods.description: Calculates the size and offsets for a specific shard, considering mesh and placement.

methods.name: tuple[tuple[int,...],tuple[int,...]] _compute_local_shape_and_global_offset( global_shape: ShapeType, mesh_shape: ShapeType, my_coordinate: list[int] | Callable[[int], RankType] | None, placements: Sequence[Placement], skip_offset: bool = False, )
methods.description: Determines local tensor shape and global offsets based on global shape, mesh shape, device coordinate, and placements, handling uneven sharding.

methods.name: tuple[list[int],list[int]] compute_local_tensor_info( global_tensor: torch.Tensor, mesh: DeviceMesh, placements: Sequence[Placement], )
methods.description: Derives local tensor size and stride from a global tensor, mesh, and placements, considering sharding.

methods.name: torch.Size compute_global_tensor_shape( shape: torch.Size, mesh: DeviceMesh, placements: Sequence[Placement] )
methods.description: Calculates the overall shape of a distributed tensor from local shape, device mesh, and placements, supporting uneven sharding.

methods.name: DeviceMesh try_find_mesh_from_args( op_call: torch._ops.OpOverload, args: Sequence[object] )
methods.description: Extracts the device mesh object from function arguments involved in distributed tensor operations.

methods.name: tuple[int,...] compute_local_stride( global_stride: ShapeType, mesh: DeviceMesh, placements: Sequence[Placement] )
methods.description: Computes stride for local shard based on global stride, device mesh, and placements, assuming even sharding.

methods.name: torch.Size normalize_to_torch_size(size)
methods.description: Normalizes a size input (int, list, tuple, or torch.Size) to torch.Size format.

methods.name: None assert_no_mixed_partial_types(placements: Sequence[Placement])
methods.description: Ensures that a list of placement objects does not contain mixed types of Partial reduce operations.
